notes: robots.txt 200, permissive (only 'User-agent: *', no Disallow). Dead routes: /sitemap.xml is a FLAT urlset of just the ~68 newest articles (generated 2026-10-25T15:50-03:00) and ?page=2 returns the same 16879 bytes, so no pagination; /sitemap-news.xml 200 but a Google-News urlset covering only ~2-3 days (151 entries, 2026-10-20..25); /sitemap/images-full/sitemap-index.xml and /sitemap/videos-full/... are monthly gzips of article URLs WITHOUT any date; /sitemap/articles-full/sitemap-index.xml 404, /sitemap/sitemap-index.xml 403, /sitemap/index.xml 404, /archivo 404, /rss 404, /feed 200 but HTML not a feed, /ultimas-noticias?page=N and ?fecha= ignore the parameter (same 21 links), /edicion/2026/10/20 and /2026/10/20 404. Route that works: /sitemap/news-full/sitemap-index.xml (200) lists one gzip per MONTH back to 1998 (/sitemap/news-full/sitemap-YYYYMM.xml.gz); sitemap-202609.xml.gz 200 1031124 B and sitemap-202610.xml.gz 200 763533 B are flat urlsets carrying <loc> plus <lastmod> per article (gzip is decompressed by polite_fetch, no manual gunzip). Two requests cover the whole window. Date = <lastmod>, but lastmod is CMS EDIT time: measured on 67 random articles, 1 was 2+ days late (an updated piece), so article ids (-nNNNNNNN, monotone in time) are used as an independent estimate - any item whose lastmod sits >1 day above the median lastmod of its +-50 id neighbourhood (376 of 4008) is fetched and re-dated from the page's own JSON-LD datePublished; 77 of those moved, 299 confirmed. Result: 4008 URLs, 31 days, all dates inside 2026-09-25..2026-10-25, no duplicates (2026-09-30: 165, 2026-10-10: 70, 2026-10-20: 186; thin days are weekends at 66-80, thick weekdays 140-206). Verified by re-fetching 80 random URLs: 0 with a page date more than 1 day from the listed date; 200 random pages checked for body text, all above 1500 chars except one quiniela results page at 1499 (median 4700). Runs 6 min cold (376 page fetches at the polite ~1-2 req/s), seconds warm.
